title: The Last Picture Show
description: A woman in a silver satin gown sits alone in a dilapidated, decaying theater, holding a film reel while looking back over her shoulder. Behind her, a large cracked movie screen displays an endless glowing cyan corridor of repeating theater doorways framed by red curtains.
prompt: A beautiful woman in a 1940s silver satin gown sits in a worn red theater chair inside a ruined cinema, holding a large film reel on her lap and looking back over her shoulder with a concerned expression. The walls and ceiling are heavily cracked and peeling. Behind her a massive damaged movie screen shows an infinite glowing cyan recursive hallway of repeating theater entrances with red curtains and chandeliers, dramatic beams of light cutting through dusty air, dark moody atmosphere, highly detailed digital painting
